description.value: Myth Dessert & Patisserie is a cozy Richmond dessert shop specializing in handcrafted sweet soups and pastries made with natural ingredients. The shop features a minimalist, sunlit interior with greenery and wooden furnishings, designed for quiet moments or social gatherings. It is part of the Myth Group restaurant family, with a loyalty points program redeemable across all Myth Group locations.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (14 spaces) at 25m; rack at 63m; rack at 70m; rack at 82m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms this is a real, operating dessert shop at 8100 Ackroyd Road #155 Richmond BC V6X 3K2, matching the OSM address. The phone number (778) 297-6600 appears on the website. The website describes a dessert patisserie serving handcrafted sweet soups and desserts; no mention of bike parking, water refill, groceries, washrooms, or any cycling-related amenities.
concerns: OSM category is shop=bakery but the business is primarily a dessert/patisserie shop serving sweet soups — category mismatch with directory's Groceries classification.
Address in OSM omits unit number and postal code; website provides full address: 8100 Ackroyd Road #155, Richmond BC V6X 3K2.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible dessert shop confirmed by website content; a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a rest and sweet refreshment.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags this as shop=bakery; it is a dessert and patisserie shop, not a grocery store. However, the bakery tag loosely fits and no better directory category may apply.
